title: Ed May worked with Prince Hans-Adam

tellings.quote: He talks about working with the Royal Prince of Liechtenstein, Hans Adam.

plain: A scientist named Ed May, linked to Stargate, a US government project that studied psychic abilities, is said to have worked with Hans-Adam II, the reigning prince of Liechtenstein. Michels mentions it in passing, saying May "talks about working with the Royal Prince of Liechtenstein." It would tie that psychic research to a European royal.
